title: Optimal Synchronous/Asynchronous Multi-Layered Design of Java Applications
content: This paper focused on the optimal design of multi-layered applications in Java, in the context of database access. The existence of various alternatives, synchronous or asynchronous, that each layer may select from, requires an analysis and the examination of the criteria that need to be considered for optimal performance. Current Java frameworks dedicated to building the web layer include MVC (synchronous) and WebFlux (asynchronous). We'll examine them in the context of interacting with multiple databases using either a synchronous (JDBC) or an asynchronous (R2DBC) driver.
